scenes.basis: 28:1 "When we had escaped, then they learned that the island was called Malta"; 28:2 "The natives showed us uncommon kindness"; 28:7 "in the neighborhood of that place were lands belonging to the chief man of the island, named Publius"
28:12 "Touching at Syracuse, we stayed there three days" - 28:11 setting sail from Malta is the departure leg

28:13 "on the second day we came to Puteoli"; 28:14 "where we found brothers, and were entreated to stay with them for seven days" - Rhegium (28:13) is a one-day touch; "So we came to Rome" is the onward leg
28:16 "When we entered into Rome, the centurion delivered the prisoners to the captain of the guard" - 28:15's meeting at the Market of Appius and the Three Taverns is the approach leg
28:17 "After three days Paul called together those who were the leaders of the Jews"; 28:23 "When they had appointed him a day, many people came to him at his lodging"
28:30 "Paul stayed two whole years in his own rented house, and received all who were coming to him" - the continuing ministry follows the Roman lodging of 28:23; the chapter names no city
